description: Na₃BiH₈O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two H and six O atoms. There is one shorter (2.47 Å) and one longer (2.54 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.53 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two H and six O atoms. There is one shorter (2.41 Å) and one longer (2.52 Å) Na-H bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.58 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent BiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.53 Å. Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted BiO₅ square pyramids that share edges with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one BiO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.43 Å. There are eight inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.56 Å) H-O bond length. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the seventh H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.01 Å. In the eighth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na, one Bi, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Bi atoms to form edge-sharing ONa₃Bi₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to four Na, one Bi, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na, one Bi, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms.
